status.summary: Strawweight contender who has won two straight since losing a five-round decision to Zhang Weili for the title at UFC 312 (Feb 8, 2025; 49-46, 49-46, 49-45). She beat Amanda Lemos 29-28 x3 at Noche UFC (Sep 13, 2025) and choked out Loopy Godinez with a rear-naked choke at 2:29 of round 2 at UFC 327 in Miami (Apr 11, 2026). She is 9-1 in the UFC, counting her TUF 23 final win. The strawweight champion is Mackenzie Dern (won at UFC 321, Oct 25, 2025; defended at UFC 330, Aug 15, 2026). Her ranking, next booking and injuries could not be checked on the web in this pass: the shared search budget was spent and direct page fetches were blocked.

style.summary: A wrestler who shoots constantly, chains attempts against the fence and wins with control, ground strikes and chokes: 5 of her 9 UFC wins are submissions. Her striking is mostly a way into the clinch. When the takedown does not come, as against Zhang Weili, she has little else. She has never been knocked down in the UFC.

moves.notes: Weights are relative within each target group, as src/director.js uses them: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1. spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. In fighters.json her decayed significant attempts go 45.6% head, 36.5% body and 17.9% legs (landed 25.6/46.6/27.8; career attempts 60.7/25.1/14.2). Against the strawweight average of 75.6/15.2/9.2 she is extremely body- and leg-heavy. Much of the body work comes in the clinch (21.5% of her decayed attempts, against a division 8%), which the director draws from its own clinch table. No web scouting source could be read in this pass, and ufcstats does not log strike types, so the within-group splits are judgement. The head group is a simple punch split with almost no head kicks, to fit a wrestler using strikes to close distance. Hooks lead the body group. Legs are split evenly because the data cannot tell calf kicks from inside kicks; she landed 9 of 11 vs Lemos and 9 of 14 vs Zhang. knee 0.30 reflects her clinch-heavy body work, which is judgement. elbow 0.10 covers top strikes. No spinning attacks appear in her data. Low confidence for the within-group splits.

Submission threat: 0.61 attempts per 15 min decayed against a division 0.40. Five of her 9 UFC wins are submissions: two guillotines, two rear-naked chokes and a D'Arce.
